spans.s: गद् vt. 1P (pp. गदित) To speek articulately, to speak, to say, to relate, to enumerate, जगादाग्रे गदाग्रजम् Sis.ii.69 or शुद्धांतरक्ष्या जगदे कुमारी R.vi.45.With नि-, to declare, to say.
गद (I) m. 1. Speaking, speech, a sentence; 2. disease, sickness, जनपदे न गदः पदमादधौ R.ix.4, xvii.81, Sr.
; 3. thunder.
गद (II) n. A kind of poison.
गदा f. A mace, a club, संचुर्णयामि गदया न सुयोधनोरू Ve.i.
गद-अगद m. du. the two Aśvins, the physicians of gods.
गद-अग्रणी m. the chief of all diseases, i.e. consumption.
गद-अंबर m. a cloud.
गद-अराति m. a drug, a medicament.
गदयित्नु (I) a. 1. Loquacious, talkative; 2. libidinous, lustful.
गदयित्नु (II) m. A name of Kāma, the god of love.
गदा-अग्रपाणि a. having a mace in the right hand.
गदा-धर m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
गदा-भृत् (I) a. a club-bearer, one who fights with a mace.
गदा-भृत् (II) m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
गदा-युद्ध n. a fight with clubs.
गदा-हस्त a. armed with a mace.
गदिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Armed with a club, Bg.xi.17; 2. sick, diseased.
गदिन् (II) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
गदिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Armed with a club, Bg.xi.17; 2. sick, diseased.
गद्गद (I) a. (f. दा) Stammering, stuttering, तत्किं रोदिषि गद्गदेन वचAm.
, सानंदगद्गदपदं हरिरित्युवाच Git.G.x. (used adverbially also, विललाप स बाष्पगद्गदम् R.viii.43).
गद्गद (II) m.n. Stammering, indistinct or convulsive utterance.
गद्गद (I) a. (f. दा) Stammering, stuttering, तत्किं रोदिषि गद्गदेन वचAm.
, सानंदगद्गदपदं हरिरित्युवाच Git.G.x. (used adverbially also, विललाप स बाष्पगद्गदम् R.viii.43).
गद्गद-ध्वनि m. low inarticulate sound expressive of joy or grief.
गद्गद-वाच् f. speech interrupted by sobbing &c.
गद्गद-स्वर (I) a. uttering stammering sounds.
गद्गद-स्वर (II) m. 1. indistinct or stammering utterance; 2. a buffalo.
गद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) To be spoken or uttered, Bt.vi.47.
गद्य (II) n. Prose composition (not metrical but framed in accordance with harmony), K.D.i.11.
गद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) To be spoken or uttered, Bt.vi.47.
गद्याण m. A weight equal to 48 gunjās.
